axes.note: glTF export: vehicle faces +Z, its left side is +X. Origin on the ground midway between axles and wheels.

suspensionGeometry.note: hub positions are the raycast wheel attachment points when the vehicle sits at rest on flat ground; model hubs are at y = wheelRadius

wheelNodeRotation: Wheel_*: pivot at hub, no baked rotation. Spin about local X, steer about local Y (apply steer first, then spin). Right-side wheels are mirrored geometry, so the same spin sign works on both sides.

steeringWheelNode.spinAxis: local +Z (column axis); multiply the rest rotation by rotateZ(angle). Driver seat is on the LEFT (x=+0.38).

collider.note: chassis box suggestion (width incl. flares, tub+cabin height, bumper to bumper); not part of the glb

customisationNodes: none yet (paint = Body material; wheels = Rim material); extra slots to be added in S7

stats._status: STARTING VALUES ONLY, NOT TUNED. Forma's guesses so the physics owner has something to load; physics owner (SpaceX/Pixel) owns and should overwrite these.
